content: औचित्यम्, औचिती [उचित-ष्यञ् यलोपे ङीष्] .²1 Aptness, fitness, propriety, suitableness. .²2 Congruity or fitness, as one of the several circumstances which determine the exact meaning of a word in a sentence (such as संयोग, वियोग <ab>&c.</ab>); सामर्थ्यमौचिती देशः कालो व्यक्तिः स्वरादयः <ls>S. D. 2</ls>; in the example पातु वो दयितामुखम् there is औचिती or fitness in taking मुख to mean सांमुख्यम् (meeting) instead of आननम्. .²3 Habituation.
